properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 13 at 9:57AM EDT until September 13 at 4:00PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Upton has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in New Jersey...

Saddle River near Lodi affecting Bergen County.

For the Saddle River...including Lodi...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Saddle River near Lodi.

* WHEN...From this morning to this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 5.5 feet, Saddle River begins to overflow into the
back parking lot of the Boys and Girls club.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:45 AM EDT Sunday the stage was 5.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 5.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
afternoon to a crest of 5.7 feet this afternoon. It will then
fall below flood stage this afternoon.
- Flood stage is 5.5 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 6.1
feet on 01/27/1996.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 400 PM EDT.

properties.description:
At 937 AM EDT, emergency management and PennDOT reported flash
flooding. Several road closures have been reported in portions of
Delaware, Philadelphia and Bucks counties due to flooding. Small
creeks are running high in Delaware and Philadelphia counties,

The heaviest rain continues to end from west to east across the
warned area. The expected rainfall rate is 0.25 to 1 inch in 1 hour.
Flash flooding is already occurring.

flooding.

areas, highways, streets and underpasses.
